en: My name is Steven. I'm interested in rare stones, so I travel here and there looking for them.
Oh? A letter for me? From my father, it seems... Thank you for bringing it all this way.
This is a thank-you for your trouble. It's a TM I'm rather fond of.
Your Pokémon seem to trust you a great deal. You might even become the Champion one day.
Let's register each other in our PokéNavs, so we can keep in touch.
I'm afraid I have to hurry along now. I'm sure we'll meet again.
Hello. I'm Steven. I came here looking for rare stones. Did you come for the same thing?
